AWS Lambda adds support for Node.js 26
changes.detail: AWS Lambda now supports creating serverless applications using Node.js 26, for both Lambda Web Functions and Lambda Event Functions. Developers can use Node.js 26 as both a managed runtime and a base container image (Event Functions only). AWS will automatically apply updates to the managed runtime and base image as they become available. Node.js 26 is the latest long-term support release of Node.js and is expected to be supported for security and bug fixes until April 2029. changes.title: Amazon RDS for Db2 now supports new Canadian time zones
changes.detail: ​​Amazon RDS for Db2 now supports four new time zones, America/Vancouver, America/Edmonton, America/Inuvik, and America/Winnipeg, that reflect the updated local time rules for British Columbia, Alberta, the Northwest Territories, and Manitoba in Canada. changes.title: Amazon RDS Custom now supports the latest Cumulative Update and GDR updates for Microsoft SQL Server
changes.detail: Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) Custom for SQL Server now supports the latest Cumulative Updates (CU) and General Distribution Release (GDR) updates for Microsoft SQL Server. This release includes support for SQL Server 2019 CU32 + GDR KB5128494 (RDS version 15.00.4500.2.v1) and SQL Server 2022 CU27 + GDR KB5126934 (RDS version 16.00.4305.5.v1). For additional information on the improvements and fixes included in these updates, see Microsoft documentation for KB5128494 and KB5126934. changes.title: AWS Lambda MicroVMs now supports customer managed keys in AWS KMS
changes.detail: AWS Lambda MicroVMs now supports customer managed keys (CMK) in AWS Key Management Service (KMS) for data encryption at rest. CMK gives you full control over the lifecycle and usage of your KMS keys , helping meet compliance requirements in regulated industries like financial services and healthcare. Lambda MicroVMs is a serverless compute primitive that provides VM-level isolation, near-instant launch and resume, and state preservation for executing user or AI generated code.
